_note: Carrholme Services office kit (WAVE2_BUILD.md D12, P-KC). Tiles are px/32 on the 10x10 Care Laundry map room_aw_carrholme. Yusuf Demir is the only kit colleague (ca11, observed; PLAN 8.3), so there is no pool: _maybePair needs two drinkers at a capacity-2 source and there is never a second (npc-needs.js:4490-4502). The map draws no source for a non-work need, so the kit declares a water_cooler with an explicit position, using the preloaded water_cooler1.png (24x47, game.js). With no drawn cooler to bind to, rooms.js creates the sprite by the fallback (findMatchFor returns null, then createSpriteAtRandomPosition and applyScenarioObjectPosition, ~2447-2510) and moves it to position; the cooler has no collision body (static bodies go only to tables and wheeled chairs, rooms.js ~2805-2834), so click-to-move routes round it (path-avoid.js water_cooler pattern, 47px over the 40px floor). position is tiles, room-relative, the sprite top-left corner; useFrom is from the sprite centre (npc-needs.js describe/approachCell). Cooler at column 8, rows 5-7, below the wall-hung extinguisher and under the kiosk's bottom edge (kiosk covers rows 3-4 of cols 7-8; the linen cart covers rows 8-9); clear of the learner's start (6,6.2) to host (5.5,3.8) and the kiosk. Used from the front (south). Yusuf's home is a chair on the north side of the shared desk (left of the room), well clear of the learner path. The test fixture test_ca_office_kit keeps shortened timings through the override on its episodes.json row.
